thread:
Asha: Uploaded a new angle for the launch post (v2) to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch-angle-v2. Need quick alignment on hero claim, CTA language, and HS routing before we hand to Ops. Can everyone review?

Priya: Skimming now. What's the hero claim we're leaning into? Performance or cost?

Asha: Primary hero: "Production-grade inference at predictable cost". Secondary highlight: latency and cost numbers but we need legal-safe phrasing.

Marco: Legal: avoid absolute superlatives. Suggested phrasing: "Production-grade inference with up to 2x sustained throughput in our internal tests" and include a footnote: "Benchmarks measured on Redwood internal harness; results may vary by workload and config."

Ken: For HubSpot mapping: we want two separate flows: webinar -> form 'launch_webinar_may22', API trial -> form 'launch_api_may22'. UTMs: utm_campaign=launch_may22, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Webinar URL should include ?ref=blog_webinar_may22 to track referrals.

Zoe: Design needs exact CTA copy for the hero buttons and the 1200x628 open graph image text. Also need the benchmark chart PNGs by 10:30am to hit export.

Sam: Bench update: internal microbench shows sustained ~2.0x throughput vs baseline and median token cost ~15% lower. Recommend phrase "~2x sustained throughput" with Marco's footnote. I'll attach the chart slices.

Priya: CTA options (pick one pair; choose exact copy):
1) "Register for live demo" / "Start free API trial"
2) "Save your seat" / "Create a trial key"

Asha: Preference for #1 for clarity. Also can we add a tiny qualifier under webinar CTA: "Seats limited; recording provided"?

Ken: OK. I'll set the HS forms to add tags 'blog_webinar_may22' and 'blog_api_may22'. Zapier will post to CRM and tag leads accordingly. I'll also configure a thank-you redirect to /thanks?src=blog_may22.

Marco: Legal LGTM on the numeric phrasing + footnote. Please ensure the footnote appears visibly near benchmark numbers and on the landing page.

Zoe: Will export hero OG with the exact copy: "Production-grade inference at predictable cost" and add two CTA button assets: "Register for live demo" and "Start free API trial". Need final copy by 9:45am.

Sam: Uploading chart PNGs now to the Drive folder. Using the qualifier in the caption.

Asha: Ops handoff checklist: final copy approved, HS forms created, UTM + redirect, hero image uploaded, webinar room reserved. Maria-ops can you confirm scheduling and overflow plan?

Maria-ops: Can do. Planning: cap live seats at 300; overflow -> recording + two office hours slots next week. I'll schedule webinar vendor room and staging publish for 2pm PT on launch day. Will confirm HS form URL and registration page by 5pm today.

Priya: LGTM from marketing side. One tiny copy tweak: change intro sentence to "Today we're announcing" instead of "We're excited to".

Ken: HS forms created and zaps queued. Will finalize redirects once Maria confirms the URL.

Marco: Legal: LGTM. Confirm the footnote text is exactly: "Benchmarks measured on Redwood internal harness; results may vary by workload and config."

Zoe: LGTM. Uploading final 2x assets now.

Asha: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD I'll mark as final and hand to Ops for staging.
